bio_md:
# 前少帝 · 主要事迹

前少帝刘恭是吕后以「惠帝后宫子」之名立起来的幼帝：[[han-hui-di|汉惠帝]]崩后，吕后临朝称制，立其后宫子为帝以续汉统，实权尽在吕氏。这个名分自始便有争议——朝臣心知他未必是惠帝血胤，史书也以「吕太后本纪」而非少帝本纪记其事。

他在位的四年，是吕氏权势登顶的四年：高后元年王诸吕，封吕氏为王，直破[[han-gao-zu|高祖]]的白马之约；高后称制下的法令亦随之调整。少帝本人不过系年而已，朝政皆出吕后。

少帝渐长，自知非皇后所生，口出怨言，遂于高后四年被幽杀，吕后更立恒山王刘弘，即后少帝。四年之间，汉家帝座两易其主而皆由吕氏摆布，直到[[han-wen-di|汉文帝]]入立，刘氏才算真正收回帝权。史家于前少帝多存名分之疑，图鉴故以「准帝」立页。

> 参考：点校本《史记·吕太后本纪》、《汉书》卷003《高后纪》，谭图第 2 册。

bio_parts_en.value: Liu Gong, the Former Young Emperor, was the child ruler raised by Empress Lü under the fiction of being a son of the harem of

. After Hui died, Lü took the regency and enthroned one of his harem sons to continue the Han line, while all real power rested with the Lü house. The legitimacy of the arrangement was doubtful from the start — the court knew the boy was probably not of Hui's blood, and the histories record his reign not in his own annals but in the "Basic Annals of Empress Lü."

His four years were the apex of Lü power: in the first year of the regency the Lü were enfeoffed as kings, breaking the White Horse Covenant of

, and the laws were adjusted to the regency's taste. The young emperor was no more than a date in the annals.

Growing up, he learned he was not the empress's son and spoke resentfully; in the fourth year of the regency he was imprisoned and slain, and Liu Hong, king of Hengshan, was enthroned in his place — the Later Young Emperor. Within four years the Han throne changed hands twice, both times at Lü's pleasure, until the accession of

returned real sovereignty to the Liu house. The histories leave the Former Young Emperor's legitimacy an open question; this gazetteer therefore lists him as a quasi-emperor.

> References: the punctuated critical edition of the *Shiji*, "Basic Annals of Empress Lü," and the *Hanshu*, ch. 3 (Benji of Empress Lü); Tan Qixiang's atlas, vol. 2.
